notes.title: Bub-O Burst is Out Now!
notes.content:
We’re pleased to announce that Bub-O Burst is available now! Prepare to Burst Bub-O’s bubbles to beat the bothersome Un-bub! :D

[previewyoutube=XzkIbr3NA7w;full][/previewyoutube]

Bub-O Burst your way through addictive, score-chasing fun with fierce bubble action in this throwback to classic 2D action arcade games! It's easy to learn, but do you have the skills to master it?

Enjoy this bite-sized piece of retro nostalgia, with lots of musical variety on each run provided by our "rogue-like soundtrack"! Also, be sure to help spread the word and leave a review on Steam. Sharing and reviewing is a huge help to small indies like us! Thanks!

notes.title: Is Bub-O Burst the WORLD'S FIRST 100% "Rogue-Like" Video Game Soundtrack?!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=IUtKMCd1ViM;full][/previewyoutube]

Did we accidentally make the world's first 100% "rogue-like" soundtrack for "Bub-O Burst"?! We sit down and discuss the history of randomization in game soundtracks. You be the judge!
